marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots diminishing to light late this morning
then increasing to southeast 15 this evening. Wind increasing to southeast 20
after midnight and to southeast 30 near noon Friday. Wind increasing to
southeast 35 Friday evening. Scattered flurries ending this evening. Snow Friday
evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>
